answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 168680 Country: India Title: Fajr Salah timing Question: For example the time of Fajr salah ends at 7:10 ok I start praying at 7:08 and finish the salah at 7:12. Then my salah is valid or not? I have to pray qaza or it's ok? Answer ID: 168680 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 510/427/SD=06/1440) If the time of Fajr ends at 7:10 and your salah finished at 7:12 then according to Shariah this salah was not valid rather it became invalid. Thus it is mandatory to make qaza of it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
